notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: rows f-j are bank 'b'. In the image, the upper half of the board (labelled j..f) is therefore bank 'b'.

Circuit read from the image: resistor spans column 3 to column 6 on row h; the orange wire from pin 9 ends at 3g (same strip as resistor leg 1); the LED anode (longer, bent leg) is in column 6 (shared with resistor leg 2) and the cathode is in column 8; the black wire from GND ends at 8h (same strip as the cathode).
Schematic: pin 9 -> resistor -> LED anode; LED cathode -> GND. Resistor is 220 ohm per manual.
The Uno GND pin used is GND.1 (the one next to AREF on the digital header); any GND would work.
USB cable connects the Uno to the computer for serial data and power; the catalogue entry has no ports, so the edge is not port-specific. The computer is not modelled.
Software (Processing/Max) is not a physical part and is omitted.
